activity.notes: Michael conquered Moldavia in May 1600, displacing Ieremia Movila, and held it until the Polish-backed restoration of Ieremia in September 1600. This is recorded as a separate Moldavian rulership rather than folded into a retroactive polity called Romania.

sources.title: History and Myth in Romanian Consciousness — Central European University Press
sources.citation_text: The CEU Press glossary identifies Michael the Brave as prince of Wallachia from 1593 to 1601 and briefly also ruler of Transylvania and Moldavia in 1600.

sources.title: Die evangelischen Kirchenordnungen des XVI. Jahrhunderts, Band 24 — Heidelberger Akademie der Wissenschaften
sources.citation_text: The scholarly edition records Michael's occupation of the Principality of Moldavia in May 1600 and the collapse of his Transylvanian position in September 1600.
